change.repo: «redacted»: a hosted-calendar sync connector exposed to AI assistants over a standard tool-calling protocol

claims.claim: The server's first stdout line is a valid JSON-RPC frame: no logging-library banner precedes the protocol stream, so a strict client can parse the initialize response.

surface.how_reached: piped a credentials-free initialize handshake to the built fat JAR under `timeout`; read raw stdout exactly as a client would

claims.how_established: Built the fat JAR at S0 and S1 in isolated detached git worktrees (JDK-21 toolchain override applied identically to both; the defect is runtime stdout behaviour, unaffected by target-bytecode version). Drove each with a credentials-free initialize handshake; captured raw stdout; compared line 1. No account, no network calendar op. The captured frame PAYLOADS are genericized for anonymization (identifying protocol/version/tool fields redacted); the byte-level property under test (line 1 parses as JSON at S1 and does NOT at S0) is preserved verbatim.

artifacts.summary: line 1 = 'kotlin-logging: initializing... active logger factory: Slf4jLoggerFactory' (NOT valid JSON); the initialize frame is pushed to line 2
line 1 = the valid JSON-RPC initialize result frame; the stream parses cleanly

differential.probe: java -jar <fatjar> < initialize.jsonl   # no credentials; inspect stdout line 1
differential.s0_observed: line 1 is 'kotlin-logging: initializing...', not valid JSON; a strict JSON-RPC parse of frame 1 fails
differential.s1_observed: line 1 is the valid JSON-RPC initialize result frame; the stream parses cleanly
differential.observed_delta: the banner is removed from stdout; frame 1 goes from unparseable to a valid protocol frame

gaps.desc: Only the credentials-free protocol handshake was driven at the real surface. Live read and write operations were not exercised.
gaps.why_unverified: they are auth-gated behind a provisioned test credential and the write/update/delete paths mutate remote state; the right rung for those is a labelled mock rung or rung 0; see the case README.
